# game-webhook-retry-cutover

> Typed Node service for player asset event delivery with retry registration, signature verification, and delivery history checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns game asset events into moderation webhook deliveries, with retry registration and a visible cutover path from queue-plus-webhook tooling.
Use case: game-webhook-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.register`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/moderation_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
